stemMarkdown: Evaluate $\dfrac{1}{2 + \sqrt{3}}$ as a decimal. (Round to 6 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Multiply top and bottom by the conjugate $2 - \sqrt{3}$: $\dfrac{2 - \sqrt{3}}{2^2 - 3} = \dfrac{2 - \sqrt{3}}{1} = 0.267949$.
altSolutionMarkdown: Rationalising does not change the value — it just moves the irrational part to the numerator.
